item.title: Show books collection dynamic with Javascript
item.description:
On this website, I have a bookcollection. All the books I have on my Kindle, are displayed here. Showing the cover, a summary, key takeaways. In addition to that, I have added tags to each book, so I can filter the collection and only show the books with that specific tag.

However, these pages with books per tag are a lot more boring than the general collection of books, where we are showing all the covers. So, showing the books with covers on the filtered pages would be nice. But, when thinking about that, it seems that having the content for the book-information in a csv or a JSON is a lot more practical: easier to maintain and update, faster to display and filter.
